# Remote Control Agent v0.1.49 — native macOS distribution candidate

This reviewed **five-platform** Agent release candidate extends the existing Linux x64/ARM64 and Windows x64 self-contained assets with native **macOS 15+ ARM64 and Intel x64** assets. Existing Worker, signed WSS pairing protocol, device identity, local SQLite receipts, session ownership and official GitHub release pipeline are reused; no alternate service or auto-updater.

## macOS coverage
- Self-contained pinned Node.js 24 and native Darwin owned-group Supervisor for each native architecture; hardware/architecture checks reject Rosetta masquerading as Intel hardware.
- Owner-confirmed temporary 24-hour foreground and permanent login-scoped LaunchAgent modes, signed WSS activation, private identity/receipts and fail-closed local `rca status|stop|start` CLI.
- SHA-256-pinned local source and archive validation, owner-confirmed side-by-side upgrade, intentional OFF state preservation, bounded rollback/Unknown handling, and launchd deregistration synchronization.
- The existing production Worker public macOS install route remains **unavailable** until a separately reviewed and authorized Worker release/pin and real publication check. A successful Agent Release does not imply the Worker route or device upgraded.

## Evidence and limitations
- Source: Agent [PR #95](https://github.com/lirtual/remote-control-agent/pull/95) and [PR #109](https://github.com/lirtual/remote-control-agent/pull/109); Worker installer source [PR #673](https://github.com/lirtual/mcp-workers/pull/673). Native macOS ARM64/x64 and existing Linux/Windows CI required on the exact candidate commit before any publication.
- Verified physical Apple Silicon permanent owner Mac: install, stop-preserving upgrade, complete rc.4 Stop → immediate Start, authenticated signed WSS, unchanged permanent ID, LaunchAgent/receipt preservation.
- **Waived by the owner, not passed:** real login/logout reconnection; sleep/wake reconnection; physical fault-injected upgrade rollback; independent physical Intel x64 Mac E2E. Hosted Intel native CI supports only native compilation and tested behavior, **not** actual Intel-Mac installation.
- Other unperformed real-system cases (including protected folder/TCC denial and Gatekeeper negative paths) are not implicitly Pass or waived. Deployment readiness and any additional required risk acceptance must be recorded separately.

## macOS trust and ownership
- These unsigned/unnotarized archives are **not Apple Developer ID authenticated**. SHA-256 verifies pinned bytes, not macOS publisher identity or Gatekeeper permission. If macOS blocks execution, the owner must use only Apple-supported manual approval, or mark the installation Blocked. Never disable Gatekeeper globally, remove quarantine automatically, change TCC, request privileged login, or alter unrelated identities.

## Publication boundary
This note and the five-asset manifest may be prepared in a **Draft PR** without publishing. **Do not merge the release Pin to main until the owner separately approves this exact immutable Agent Release**: merging a change under `.github/release-pins/*.json` triggers the existing GitHub Actions publisher. A Worker production rollout and final public installer activation also require separate explicit authorization.

Related: [Spec #657](https://github.com/lirtual/mcp-workers/issues/657), [#660](https://github.com/lirtual/mcp-workers/issues/660), [#661](https://github.com/lirtual/mcp-workers/issues/661), [#662](https://github.com/lirtual/mcp-workers/issues/662).
